appPairing.approved.note: {name} receives its credential the next time it asks. It is listed with your credentials, where you can revoke it.
appPairing.approved.title: Approved
appPairing.code.note: The code the app shows, such as BCDF-GHJK.
appPairing.denied.note: {name} is told the next time it asks, and receives nothing.
appPairing.denied.title: Denied
appPairing.empty.heading: Type the code the app shows
appPairing.empty.note: An app that wants to reach this server shows a short code. Type it here to see what it asks for.
appPairing.note: An app asks for a credential that speaks for you. It never reaches more than you can.
appPairing.title: Pair an app
appPairing.trust.note: The name is what the app says about itself, and nothing checks it. Approve only an app you started yourself.
appPairing.trust.title: Check that you started this app
